name: qlbx-erp-android
description: QLBX ERP Android wrapper using Capacitor 7

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const s=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); const checks=[['HTML entry',s.includes('<html')],['app title',s.includes('QLBX ERP')],['IndexedDB persistence',s.includes(\"indexedDB.open('qlbx_erp'\")],['mobile viewport',s.includes('viewport-fit=cover')],['mobile navigation',s.includes('mobile-nav')],['native bridge',s.includes('native-bridge.js')],['mobile hardening',s.includes('Android/mobile hardening')]]; for(const [n,ok] of checks){console.log((ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+n); if(!ok)process.exitCode=1;}"
